# peakhour_domain (Data Source)

Fetches information about an existing Peakhour domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "peakhour_domain" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Domain name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Domain identifier.
